summary: Absolute barrier repair. A deeply occlusive, restorative balm that heals micro-tears and chronic dryness.
description: Structural integrity for the lips. This thick, long-wearing treatment mimics the skin’s natural lipid barrier to instantly trap moisture, actively repairing wind-chapped or compromised lip tissue.
technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 10ml, this KoColor LIP_CARE is expertly formulated with Ceramide NP, Shea Butter, and Phytosqualane. It delivers a high-fidelity Sheer Pink color profile (`#FFC0CB`) and leverages bio-identical lipid restoration.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply a thick layer before bed as an overnight restorative mask.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Use a microscopic amount under matte lipstick to prevent dehydration without disrupting the pigment's grip.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Free from petroleum, utilizing high-molecular-weight plant waxes to create a breathable yet impenetrable moisture seal.
